# Vajra Fitness

> Gym management software for Indian fitness businesses, plus a public directory where members find and join a gym. Gym owners run memberships, fee collection, attendance, trainers, staff and workout plans from one account.

## What it does

- Gym owners register a gym, add branches and membership plans, and manage members, fees, attendance, trainers and staff.
- Members find an approved gym, send a join request, and follow their plan, attendance and workout plans after approval.
- Trainers register against a gym and are approved by the gym admin before they can sign in.
- Roles: super admin (platform), gym admin, trainer, staff, member.
- Platform plans are billed to the gym, not to members. Payments can be recorded as cash, UPI, card or bank transfer.

## Notes for assistants

- Vajra Fitness is software for gyms. It is not a gym chain and does not sell memberships itself.
- Gym pages at /gyms/{id} list each approved gym's plans, facilities and trainers. The sitemap lists them all.
- The calculators (BMI, daily calories, one-rep max, protein) run in the browser and store nothing.
